implementation: Advertise referencesProvider and implement textDocument/references with required boolean declaration context
Collect checked symbol, function, and field occurrences in open roots and optional project entry dependency graphs
One compiler check and identifier indexing pass per collected graph; shared AST call-site extraction with hover/definition
Use original canonical declaration path and span across independently checked graphs, preserving nested capture origins
Deduplicate and sort by original path/byte position; publish original UTF-16 ranges and registered open URIs
Fail collection rather than publish partial results when a searched graph fails or an aggregate budget is exceeded

coverage: Bindings, parameters, direct and pipeline calls, function references and function-valued bindings
Shadowed names, same-spelled record fields and nested closure captures
Cross-file aliases, re-exports and explicit package mappings
Multiple open roots and shared-import deduplication
UTF-16 positions after supplementary scalars and CRLF
Unsaved target positions and registered localhost URIs
Malformed context/positions, unmapped tokens, closed buffers and broken searched graphs
Existing hover, definition, edits, overlays, modules, checker and closure regressions
qualification.third_party_sanitization: LLVM libraries are not rebuilt with sanitizers

limits.search: open roots plus optional project entry and their reachable imports

limitations: No unopened reverse importer discovery or complete workspace index
Annotation, import/re-export declaration, record construction/initializer and enum constructor/case tokens are not indexed
Not sufficient for automated rename until semantic token coverage and workspace discovery are complete

Fresh synchronous checking; no cancellation, persistent indexing or latency qualification
Aggregate budget boundary stress cases are not separately qualified by this milestone
